result:
**Round 295 verdict: PASS.** All 10 rows I can run here passed. Real-browser rows were run, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. The full suite, build, Biome, `verify` and `test:e2e:smoke` are left to root's gate.

**A's STOP:** A stopped because two claim results were not on the task's list of allowed changes. Both come from B's task, not from A's work. A applied B's sketch exactly, and I confirmed the 7 changed files are byte-identical to it.
- **K6:** the extra import is the one the task's §3.2 grants, but §6 forgot to list it.
- **K10:** the extra match in `perf/lib/report.test.ts` is the LOAF1 test title, copied word for word from B's sketch (line 192).

I logged this as **C-R295-INFO-01** (info, from B). It does not change the verdict. B should build the list of allowed claim changes by running the claims script on a copy with the sketch already applied.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| CLAIMS | My run gives the same output as A's. Every difference traces to the task or the sketch. |
| SOURCE-SCOPE | Exactly the 8 granted paths changed. The hash check fails only on the 7 edited files. No app source outside tests and none of the 7 protected files changed. |
| TYPECHECK | rc 0 |
| UNIT | 85 of 85 pass in 4 files, including DW12 (4 cases), DW12b, SD10 (2 cases) and ZQ3. The slowest test used 23 % of its timeout. |
| UNIT-PERF | 23 of 23 pass, including the 4 LOAF1 cases. I ran them with a throwaway config in a scratch copy, never in `store/`. |
| UNIT-MUTANTS | Each of the four deliberate breakages (a)–(d) turns its new test red. The two control checks pass: under (b) the old UI12 test stays green, and under (c) the old ZQ3 test stays green. So the old tests really could not fail. Every scratch file was restored and compared byte for byte. |
| B-LOAF-REAL | In real Chromium at 1440×900: 5 long-frame entries, 4 with script timings, 1 with an empty list. At 1280×720: 6 entries, 5 with timings, 1 empty. So the stricter check can be met. |
| B-PERF-LOAF | The perf harness ran alone for 7.0 minutes and passed. It reported 0 `harness.loaf-scripts` problems, and all 6 passes had no problems at all. `load.script-max` measured [56, 48, 51] ms (median 51). |
| G295-AUTH | A fresh context with no login opens `/studio-lab` as the demo, with `auth_user` null. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with 0 audio sources. The studio token endpoint answers GET with 401 and POST with 405, and neither returns a token. Premium auth is not bypassed. |
| DOC-219 | The status line is exactly as required, all 7 changed files are listed, and each of the 4 Lows has its Problem → Solution entry. The TODO is there, and every id it cites exists. |

The perf harness passing also shows that the new `scriptCount` field is actually recorded in the page. The code reviewer had pointed out that no unit test covers that.

One known gap remains: the gate does not run LOAF1 until `vitest.config.ts` includes `perf/**` (ROOT-REQ-VITEST-PERF-INCLUDE, root's item).

Ableton conformity does not apply, since this round only changed tests and the perf harness. I edited no app source and made no commits. The perf harness wrote to `store/build` and `store/test-results`, which git ignores.

The advisor was overloaded at the final review step, so this verdict has not had its second check.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-295.md
- c-round-295.json
- c-round-295/ (logs, `c295.cjs`, screenshots)
